Overview.Name: Priyanka
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results

Meal_1: Option 1: 3 egg omelette (pan fried in ghee)
Option 2: Chicken curry (small bowl) + 1/2 cup cooked rice (~75 g)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small) + 2 boiled eggs
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + fish curry (small portion) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + chicken curry + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber salad
Option 2: Chicken curry (small portion) + 1/2 cup cooked rice (~75 g)
Option 3: Paneer cubes (60–80 g) + vegetable curry (lightest option)

Notes_and_Tips: Do not skip meals. Long gaps can trigger migraine.
Keep spices moderate. Extremely spicy or oily food can worsen headaches.
Start every meal with egg, chicken or fish before eating rice.
For fried cravings, choose pan fried food instead of deep fried snacks.
Because appearance is a major goal, keep rice controlled and protein high.
Walking daily will support steady fat loss around waist and hips over 8–10 weeks.
